datasets.title: Daily Summaries of Precipitation Indicators for Micronesia, Federated States of
datasets.description: This dataset contains the daily summaries on base stations across Micronesia, Federated States of . The four indicators included are: * TPCP : Total precipitation * MXSD : Maximum snow depth * TSNW : Total snow fall * EMXP : Extreme maximum daily precipitation Indicators are compiled by the National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI), which is administrated by National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) an organization part of the United States government. NOAA has access to data collected from thousands of base stations around the world, which collect data periodically on weather and climate conditions. This dataset contains the latest 5 years of available data .. datasets.details: Due to late-arriving data, the number of recent records is likely underrepresented in all categories, but the ratio of records (warm to cold, for example) should be a fairly strong estimate of a final outcome.

lineage.description: Daily precipitation indicators were collected from base weather stations across Federated States of Micronesia and compiled by NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information. Stations were selected based on a minimum 30-year record of service with at least 182 complete days per year, ensuring data quality and temporal consistency for climate and hazard monitoring applications.
